titleEn: A space puzzle: why can't spacecraft fly straight "up"?
summaryEn:
It sounds simple: if the planets lie almost in the same plane, why not launch a spacecraft straight "up" or "down" out of the Solar System?

Physically, it is entirely possible. But the energy cost is so high that almost every mission chooses to travel along the plane of the ecliptic rather than fly perpendicular to it.
